burnaby-4399.centre_zh: 本拿比 4399 考场（Burnaby Claim Centre，4399 Wayburne Dr）
burnaby-4399.centre_en: ICBC Burnaby test centre (Burnaby Claim Centre, 4399 Wayburne Dr)
burnaby-4399.intro_zh: 本拿比 ICBC 4399 考场（Burnaby Claim Centre，4399 Wayburne Dr）的 4 条路考练习路线。路线一带有 Deer Lake Parkway、Willingdon Avenue 上下坡、Moscrop 中学学校区、公园旁 30 限速路段和多个 4-way 路口，其中一条会上 1 号高速。前三条是驾校教练全程实拍讲解，第四条是航拍 + 地图动画。
burnaby-4399.intro_en: Four practice routes for the ICBC road test at the Burnaby Claim Centre (4399 Wayburne Dr). Expect Deer Lake Parkway, the Willingdon Avenue hills, the Moscrop Secondary school zone, 30 km/h park zones and several 4-way stops; one route goes onto Highway 1. Routes 1–3 were filmed with a driving instructor explaining each turn; route 4 is an aerial-view map animation.
faq: 4399 考场在哪里？
考场在 Burnaby Claim Centre，地址 4399 Wayburne Dr, Burnaby, BC，靠近 Deer Lake Parkway。所有练习路线都从考场出发、回到考场。
Where is the Burnaby 4399 test centre?
It is at the Burnaby Claim Centre, 4399 Wayburne Dr, Burnaby, BC, next to Deer Lake Parkway. Every practice route starts and ends at the centre.
4399 考场的路考常经过哪些路段？
常见路段有 Wayburne Drive、Deer Lake Parkway、Willingdon Avenue（上下坡、限速 50）、Moscrop Street 学校区（限速 30）、Gilpin Crescent 和 Bond Street 公园旁 30 限速路段，以及 Gilmore Avenue 的 all-way stop。
Which roads do Burnaby 4399 road tests usually use?

Common roads are Wayburne Drive, Deer Lake Parkway, Willingdon Avenue (hills, 50 km/h), the Moscrop Street school zone (30 km/h), the 30 km/h park zones on Gilpin Crescent and Bond Street, and the all-way stop on Gilmore Avenue.
4399 考场的路考会上高速吗？
有一条路线会上 1 号高速：从 Willingdon Avenue 匝道并入 Highway 1 东向（限速 90），从 Exit 32 出来，再经 Canada Way 回考场。其余三条都在市区。
Does the Burnaby 4399 road test go on the highway?
One route does: it takes the Willingdon Avenue ramp onto Highway 1 east (90 km/h), leaves at Exit 32 and returns along Canada Way. The other three routes stay on city streets.
会考靠边停车和平行停车吗？
路线 1 会考靠边停车（Sardis Street）和平行停车（Shepherd Street）；路线 3 在 Fir Street 可能考靠边停车。
Are pull-over and parallel parking tested?
Route 1 includes a pull-over on Sardis Street and parallel parking on Shepherd Street; route 3 may include a pull-over on Fir Street.
这些是 ICBC 官方路线吗？
不是。路线根据驾校教练分享的路线图和公开视频整理，ICBC 没有公布官方路线，考官也可能随时调整。建议用来考前熟悉路况。
Are these official ICBC routes?

No. They are compiled from route maps shared by driving instructors and from public videos. ICBC does not publish official routes and examiners may change them at any time, so use them to get to know the roads before your test.
路线包里有什么？多少钱？
每条路线都有一个 Google 地图导航链接，手机上一键打开就能跟着开，还有路线概览图和讲解视频。路线 1 登录后免费试用；整个考场的路线包 CA$14.99，一次付款，永久查看。
What is in the route pack, and how much is it?

Every route comes with a Google Maps navigation link that opens on your phone in one tap, plus an overview map and a video. Route 1 is free once you log in; the full pack for a centre is CA$14.99, a one-time payment with no subscription.

richmond-5300.centre_zh: 列治文 Lansdowne 考场（Lansdowne Centre，5300 No. 3 Rd）
richmond-5300.centre_en: ICBC Richmond test centre (Lansdowne Centre, 5300 No. 3 Rd)
richmond-5300.intro_zh: 列治文 ICBC 考场（Lansdowne Centre，5300 No. 3 Rd）的 5 条路考练习路线，覆盖 Alderbridge Way 以北的小区（May Dr、Odlin Rd、Fisher Dr、Hall Ave）、考场南边的 Cook Rd 学校区和 Granville Ave / Gilbert Rd 一带、Capstan Way 附近的连续环岛、Shell Rd / Westminster Hwy 大圈，以及过 Dinsmore 桥去 Sea Island 的 Burkeville 小区。
richmond-5300.intro_en: Five practice routes for the ICBC road test at Lansdowne Centre (5300 No. 3 Rd), Richmond. They cover the neighbourhoods north of Alderbridge Way (May Dr, Odlin Rd, Fisher Dr, Hall Ave), the Cook Rd school zone and the Granville Ave / Gilbert Rd area south of the centre, the back-to-back roundabouts near Capstan Way, the Shell Rd / Westminster Hwy loop, and Burkeville on Sea Island over the Dinsmore Bridge.
faq: 列治文 ICBC 考场在哪里？
考场在 Lansdowne Centre 商场（5300 No. 3 Rd, Richmond, BC），出入口在商场东北角 Kwantlen St 一侧。练习路线都从 Kwantlen St 出发、回到 Kwantlen St。
Where is the ICBC Richmond test centre?
It is at Lansdowne Centre (5300 No. 3 Rd, Richmond, BC), with its entrance at the north-east corner of the mall on Kwantlen St. Every practice route leaves from and returns to Kwantlen St.
列治文考场的路考常经过哪些路段？
常见路段有 Alderbridge Way、Garden City Rd、No. 4 Rd，北区小区里的 May Dr / Odlin Rd 4-way Stop、Fisher Dr、Hall Ave，南边的 Cook Rd 学校区（限速 30）、Citation Dr 窄路、Granville Ave 和 Gilbert Rd。
Which roads do Richmond Lansdowne road tests usually use?

Common roads are Alderbridge Way, Garden City Rd and No. 4 Rd; in the north-side neighbourhoods the 4-way stop at May Dr / Odlin Rd, Fisher Dr and Hall Ave; south of the centre the Cook Rd school zone (30 km/h), narrow Citation Dr, Granville Ave and Gilbert Rd.
列治文考场的路考会上高速吗？
当地驾校教练 2026 年反馈目前不考高速。路线 5 会走 Russ Baker Way 去 Sea Island，但那是普通干道，不是高速公路。
Does the Richmond road test go on the highway?
Local driving instructors said in 2026 that the highway is not currently tested. Route 5 uses Russ Baker Way to Sea Island, which is an arterial road, not a freeway.
会考哪些停车项目？
路线 2 在 Odlin Rd 考靠边停车、在 Fisher Dr 公园旁考平行停车；路线 5 回到考场时考倒车入位。
Which parking tasks come up?
Route 2 has a pull-over on Odlin Rd and parallel parking beside the park on Fisher Dr; route 5 ends with reverse parking back at the centre.

不是。路线根据驾校教练分享的路线图和公开视频整理，ICBC 没有公布官方路线，考官也可能随时调整。建议用来考前熟悉路况。
